#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Traps on EXIT or ERR keep the main command's status and say when they fail (TXE-7857, from txe's TXE-7835).
set -euo pipefail
work=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT # want:trap-status
trap 'docker rm -f "pg-$RUN" >/dev/null 2>&1' EXIT # want:trap-status
trap 'RC=$?; docker rm -f "pg-$RUN" >/dev/null 2>&1; exit "$RC"' EXIT # want:trap-status
trap 'RC=$?; kill "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true; exit "$RC"' EXIT # want:trap-status
trap 'RC=$?; rm -rf "$work" &>/dev/null; exit "$RC"' ERR # want:trap-status
trap "RC=$?; rm -rf $work; exit \$RC" EXIT # want:trap-status
trap 'RC=$?; set +e; rm -rf "$work"; exit 0' EXIT # want:trap-status
trap 'rm -rf "$work"; exit "$RC"' EXIT # want:trap-status
trap -- 'rm -rf "$work"' 0 # want:trap-status
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' SIGEXIT # want:trap-status
trap 'docker rm -f "$cid" 2>/dev/null; exit 143' TERM # want:trap-status
trap 'RC=$? # want:trap-status
  rm -rf "$work" 2>&-
  exit "$RC"' EXIT
cleanup() {
  # don't let a quote in a comment end the body
  [ -d "$work" ] && rm -rf "$work"
}
trap cleanup EXIT # want:trap-status
quiet() { rm -rf "$work" 2>/dev/null || true; }
trap 'RC=$?; quiet; exit "$RC"' EXIT # want:trap-status

# Under set -e a failing cleanup ends the handler before its exit (connector review of PR 5227).
trap 'RC=$?; rm -rf "$work"; exit "$RC"' EXIT # want:trap-status
trap 'RC=$?; cleanup; exit "$RC"' EXIT # want:trap-status
trap 'RC=$?; rm -rf "$work" || echo "::warning::kept $work"; rm -f "$lock"; exit "$RC"' EXIT # want:trap-status
trap 'RC=$?; docker rm -f "pg" >/dev/null && echo removed; exit "$RC"' EXIT # want:trap-status

# Kept: these pass.
trap 'RC=$?; set +e; rm -rf "$work"; exit "$RC"' EXIT
trap 'RC=$?; docker rm -f "pg-$RUN" >/dev/null || echo "::warning::could not remove pg-$RUN"; exit "$RC"' EXIT
trap "RC=\$?; set +e; rm -rf \"\$work\"; exit \"\$RC\"" EXIT
trap 'RC=$?
  set +e
  rm -rf "$work"
  exit "${RC}"' EXIT
trap 'RC=$?; set +e; cleanup; exit "$RC"' EXIT
trap 'RC=$?; cleanup || echo "cleanup failed (above)" >&2; exit "$RC"' EXIT
done_rc() {
  local status=$?
  set +e
  rm -rf "$work"
  exit "$status"
}
trap done_rc EXIT
trap 'docker rm -f "$cid" >/dev/null; exit 143' TERM
trap '' TERM
trap - EXIT
trap -p EXIT
echo "trap 'rm -rf x' EXIT is text, not a trap"
cat <<'DOC'
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
it's a here-document: no trap, and the apostrophe opens no quote
DOC
trap 'RC=$?; set +e; rm -rf "$work"; exit "$RC"' EXIT
# A here-string, an arithmetic shift and an unended << hide nothing after them (connector review of PR 5227).
read -r first <<<"text"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT # want:trap-status
echo $((1<<n))
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT # want:trap-status
cat <<NEVER_ENDED
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT # want:trap-status
# A quoted signal is the same signal (connector review of PR 5227).
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' "EXIT" # want:trap-status
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' 'ERR' # want:trap-status
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' INT "EXIT" # want:trap-status
# dagu's smoke cleanup before TXE-7857: it saved the status, but under set -e a failing rm ended
# the handler before its exit, and docker's error went to /dev/null.
smoke_old() {
  status=$?
  if [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then
    timeout 10 docker logs "$container" || true
  fi
  timeout 10 docker rm -f "$container" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  rm -rf "$data_dir"
  exit "$status"
}
trap smoke_old EXIT # want:trap-status
smoke_new() {
  status=$?
  set +e
  timeout 10 docker rm -f "$container" >/dev/null || echo "::warning::could not remove $container (above)"
  rm -rf "$data_dir"
  exit "$status"
}
trap smoke_new EXIT
# A redirection named in a message or a comment is text, not a redirection (connector review of PR 292).
trap 'RC=$?; set +e; echo "cleanup did not use 2>/dev/null"; exit "$RC"' EXIT
trap 'RC=$?; set +e
  rm -rf "$work" # never 2>/dev/null here
  exit "$RC"' EXIT
trap 'RC=$?; set +e; rm -rf "$work" 2>/dev/null; echo "2>/dev/null"; exit "$RC"' EXIT # want:trap-status
